request.spec:
A steward can merge a grade into another (two selects and a button; GRADE_MERGED from=<grade>
into=<grade>; the same grade twice, or anyone else, is refused): every person whose grade in force
today is the merged grade is given the other from the sheet's today, each exactly as the person
form would (PERSON_EDITED and the rollup lines, in list order).
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A steward can merge a grade into another (two selects and a button; GRADE_MERGED from=<grade>
into=<grade>; the same grade twice, or anyone else, is refused): every person whose grade in force
today is the merged grade is given the other from the sheet's today, each exactly as the person
form would (PERSON_EDITED and the rollup lines, in list order).

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Stewards can now merge one grade into another, and `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests (the grade-merge test and the three scenario tests).

**Server** (`grade/GradeService.java`, `grade/GradeController.java`)
- There's a new endpoint, `POST /api/grades/merge`.
- Anyone who isn't a steward is refused (403), and so is choosing the same grade twice (400). A refused merge writes nothing to the store or the audit file.
- Otherwise it writes `GRADE_MERGED from=<grade> into=<grade>`. Then, in list order, it finds everyone whose grade in force today is the merged grade and edits each one through the existing person-edit code, with the new grade starting from the sheet's today. Name, terms and contact stay as they were, so each person gets the same `PERSON_EDITED` and rollup lines the person form would write.
- After all the edits it compares the sheet's figures with how they stood before the merge and writes any that moved. That's why the test expects the `ROLLUP`/`TOTALS` pair twice after Ada's edit. When nothing moves, as in the merge where Cam's only claim is already on a statement, no rollup lines are written.
- It answers with how many people it moved.

**Front end** (`features/grades/grades.ts`)
- The Grades section now has a "Merge grade" form: two selects (`grade-merge-from`, `grade-merge-into`), a button (`grade-merge`), and a count of people moved (`grade-merged`). The count is cleared while a merge runs and whenever the sheet is reloaded.
- A refused merge shows its message in the existing `grade-error` element, which the test expects. I moved that element out of the retire form so both forms use it. Its `data-testid` is unchanged.

The people list doesn't update itself after a merge, so you see the new grades only after reloading the sheet. The test reloads before it checks, so this doesn't affect it.
